targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', datetime(CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp) / (MAX((($__to) - ($__from)) / 240000, 60)) AS INTEGER) * (MAX((($__to) - ($__from)) / 240000, 60)), 'unixepoch')) AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN severity='low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low, SUM(CASE WHEN severity='medium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS medium, SUM(CASE WHEN severity='high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high, SUM(CASE WHEN severity='critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical FROM alerts WHERE timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') GROUP BY CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp) / (MAX((($__to) - ($__from)) / 240000, 60)) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY time
